Huh?
W-where are the Coenubias?!
There's not even a single monster left...\nWhere have they all gone?!
Are you positive that you saw them...? Or perhaps\nthey noticed that you had seen them...
We know what we saw, we're sure about it, right?!
Yeah, besides, when we saw them, we both did our\nbest to hide and leave quietly. I don't think\nthey'd noticed us though...
These traces prove that something passed this\nway...It seems that the Coenubias were here\nindeed, but they've moved somewhere else...
Dammit!!\nDoes that mean they noticed we were here?!
I can't believe that they still noticed us after\nwe tried so hard to hide and leave quietly!!
Well, maybe it's just a coincidence that the\nCoenubias left...For now, let's go a little\nfurther and see what we can find!
Oh, w-what's this?!
Whoa! What are these creatures?!
We have no choice but to take them down! Don't let\nyour guard down!!
Whew, it feels like we were the ones being\nambushed...There's something weird about this...
Huff, huff...When we thought they were there, they\nweren't, and when we thought they weren't there,\nthey were actually waiting to attack us...
I feel like they can tell what we're gonna do\nnext...
Some Coenubias might still be hiding around\nhere...Don't you think we need to go and take a\nlook around?
Sorry, I'll pass. I'm still tired and too lazy to\nmove because of the fight earlier. I'mma take a\nshort nap~!
I'mma take a short rest too. Oh, you can leave\nthose little kids with me, I'll watch them.
R-really?\nOkay, thank you.
Zianga!! What happened?!\nPlease hang in there!!
I...I don't know what happened...I heard someone\nscream and when I saw him, he was already on the\nground...
Mmm...huh...blah blah...
It seems that she's just sleeping!
Uhm? *yawn*\nHuh? You just woke me up from a really good sleep,\nyou know...! Eh? What happened to Zianga...?
Whaat?!\nI-I-I have no idea! I...I was just sleeping...\nO-o-oh my gosh, what do we do now?!
